title: Reduce exact dyadic inverse completion to O(N²(w+1)) (no κ)
body:
## Summary

The rounded full-cell Gaussian reference in aliromman's [PR5677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5677) is banded, but its exact fallback uses dense elimination. This isolated package supplies an exact pivoted band fallback with the identical complete rounded inverse and residual/error contract.

```diff
- exact completion: O(N^3) rational operations
+ exact completion: O(N^2(w+1)) rational operations
  complete N-by-N rounded inverse and both residual norms retained
```

Claim type: **scoped constructive written proof with exact finite corroboration**, produced by Nick Petalas. The explicit envelope is `N^2 + 2Nw + 4Nw^2 + 6N^2w` rational operations before final integer scaling/rounding. The proof covers every finite invertible integer band, including row exchanges, with no diagonal-dominance premise. The executable bounds N to 256 and entries/precisions to 4096. Storage remains O(N^2) rational entries. This partially answers Open next question 2 of PR5677.

Classical pivoted band elimination is credited as such. The new contribution is the standalone completion, explicit application proof and verifier. Credit aliromman for PR5677's reference, rounding and error contract; JoyboyBrian #5479 and the retained Gaussian/q-LDU lineage; Dugongue #4554/#5566 for different near-identity/periodic algorithms; and aliromman #5284 for the different variable-gap diagonally dominant cyclic solver. No predecessor scientific executable is replayed. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Base canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; selected #7000 unchanged. Card `uniform-transfer-audit` explicitly changes scope to this preparation result and discharges none of the five selected assumptions. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19591499).

## Evidence

Before, the cited source pays a cubic exact completion. After, the new fill/pivot proof limits lower eliminations to w rows and upper fill to 2w while retaining every right-hand side. Uniqueness of the exact inverse and the same signed tie rule preserve every output integer.

Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only:

- 2,427 matrices: 1,290 invertible and 1,137 singular. Independent dense Gauss-Jordan agrees on every accepted inverse; direct multiplication checks 52,308 two-sided identity entries. There are 508 executed row exchanges, three complete rounding comparisons per invertible matrix and fifteen rejecting controls. Two explicit negative/positive half-ties preserve the source convention.
- Three additional complete tridiagonal inversions check the exact operation counter. These counts are source-level rational operations, not timings or a claim about the best dense solver.
- Both registered warning-strict normal/optimized commands pass, individually timed at 0.975 and 0.915 seconds against separate 120-second limits. These durations establish timeout headroom only.
- Registered metadata/source pins, exact eight committed files/modes/source ancestry, syntax/function-size inspection, official export integrity and read-only Git-free normal/optimized exported replay pass. Receipts agree at the committed bytes. No generated artifact remains in the checkout.

From the worktree root, reproduce with:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/banded-dyadic-inverse-fallback/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/banded-dyadic-inverse-fallback/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/banded-dyadic-inverse-fallback
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/banded-dyadic-inverse-fallback --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Another host may substitute its CPython 3.12 executable. Expected markers are `PASS_BANDED_DYADIC_INVERSE_FALLBACK`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Direct replay emits a generated source-hash receipt; `--receipt NEW_EXTERNAL_PATH` retains one without overwriting a file. The package README and PROOF.md give full scope, source pins and the correctness/height argument.

## Limitations

The predecessor's Gaussian invertibility, conditioning and error theorem are cited premises. Finite checks corroborate the new algorithm and do not independently validate those premises. The two solvers were produced by the same contributor; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

The asymptotic gain requires w=o(N); a full band remains cubic. Dense output, fraction growth, integer rounding and source coefficient generation remain positive costs. Large Gaussian-cell exact fallback timing, predecessor/selected scientific replays, native/tape execution, physical caller integration, supplier admission and a complete multiplication theorem are unrun or unclaimed. The isolated routine is not installed into its predecessor.

## Open next questions

1. Adopt only the exact-candidate call in one actual full-cell consumer and measure fraction growth and complete preparation cost while retaining all acceptance predicates. Consumer integration and a separately budgeted large-cell run remain missing.
2. Specify a physical inverse caller that can retain band factors and avoid dense output. Required reads, reuse, residual certification, delivery and restoration costs remain open.

## Related open work

- [PR7180](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7180) proves an ideal half-shift Gaussian inverse-norm envelope; this result computes a complete inverse of a supplied rounded band and does not compute that norm.
- [PR1758](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1758) uses structured Gaussian boundary solves and fractional-shift interiors; this exact rounded-band fallback relies on band support and invertibility rather than unrounded Toeplitz displacement structure.
- [PR3910](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3910) bounds physical forward Gaussian row norms; it supplies no competing exact-completion algorithm.
- [PR371](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/371) accounts for final-grid Gaussian rounding; this result preserves the existing inverse-candidate rounding rule and leaves the physical enclosure unchanged.

- [PR7507](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7507) bounds forward and inverse amplification for errors on a common acyclic support; this exact band inversion assumes no such error-support graph and computes no competing amplification budget.

The completion check inspected this account's other open PRs created since the CLAIM: #7501, #7502, #7503, #7504, #7506, #7507 and #7509. None computes a conflicting exact-completion quantity. No shared numerical value is compared, and no additional computations were run to check those PRs.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `107cdb53ebc1bb88a6dca8c8d18a3419c8fc4f26`, [run 43437529382](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43437529382), [plan job 131926379166](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43437529382/job/131926379166), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the completed checks once and downloaded the job log. It reports exactly one failure among 760 tests, with 24 skipped:

`test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`

The AssertionError says that '`make frontier7000-verify`' was not found in `docs/ci-verification.md`. At base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, the selected record names that command while the CI guide still describes #6030. This PR changes neither file. The [package replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43437529382/job/131928634055) was skipped because planning failed.

I separately downloaded the failed logs of [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314) and [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790). Each reports the identical navigation assertion as its sole failure among 760 tests, with 24 skipped. The previously downloaded [PR7477 run 43291152300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43291152300) also has that same failure and summary. These logs confirm a shared base blocker; they do not certify this package.

All package-specific registered commands, direct normal/optimized checks, metadata/source pins, committed bytes/modes/source history and read-only Git-free exported replays passed locally at this unchanged head. No required local package check remains unrun. There is no hosted package-replay success to report. No fix, retrigger commit, push or job rerun was made for this repository-level failure; maintainers retain its repair.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated research. Only eight new package files are added; shared implementations, predecessor credit, frozen evidence and selected records are unchanged.
